messages:
Tara: Heads-up 1 — OrbitPay case draft finished. Need interview slot, logo + metric signoff, and AE routing.
Mason: Drop the one-pager here and I'll sketch social hooks.
Tara: One-pager snippet:
Tara: ```OrbitPay reduced per-transaction inference cost by 3.8x and dropped p95 from 460ms to 130ms after migrating to Redwood Dedicated. Includes migration timeline, infra notes, and exec quote placeholder.```
Devon: OrbitPay prefers a 25-30 min recorded session. They9re okay with May 30th or June 2nd. Which do we pick?
Clara: Prefer May 30th so we can publish before the June product release. Also want a 48h redline window on the draft.
Tara: I'll propose May 30th 09:00 PT and ask for logo SVG, exact metric confirmation, and 48h redline.
Mason: Suggested landing blurb: "How a payments provider cut inference costs by 3.8x while improving latency 1 a technical breakdown from migration to production." Use this for webinar and hero copy.
Devon: Routing: please send registrants to devon@redwood and tag as orbitpay-case. I'll queue the AE follow-ups.
Clara: Legal note 1 we need written permission for logo + metrics and a signed attribution line for any quote. Offer anonymization (e.g., "a leading payments platform") if they push back.
Tara: Good call. Also include an explicit consent line: "Customer confirms permission to publish metrics and logo on [DATE]."
OpsBot: AUTOMATED: Created approval checklist (case_study_approvals/3216547890). Upload signed permission within 7 days to complete flow.
Tara: Sent packet to OrbitPay legal. Asking for: logo (SVG), signed metric confirmation, preferred attribution, and whether they want anonymized numbers.
Mason: For social clips, can we capture a 30s promo and a 90s technical highlight? Will need transcript + timecodes.
Clara: Yes. We'll record to Zoom cloud, generate transcript, and clip with timestamps. @Tara can you confirm moderator?
Tara: I will moderate. Devon will run the technical demo. Mason will pull social soundbites.
LegalBot: AUTOMATED: Legal request received from OrbitPay (upload pending). Note: client requested 24-hour redline window instead of 48h.
Clara: 24h is okay. Update Ops checklist and calendar invite.
Devon: Posting interview Qs for review: 1) Can you walk through the migration steps? 2) Which metrics improved and how did you measure them? 3) Any surprises or trade-offs?
Mason: Q2 tweak: add "measurement tools and significance thresholds".
Tara: Sent updated invite for May 30 09:00 PT and attached one-click legal approval link.
Tara: Final asks before recording: confirm logo file, approved quote text, and signed permission. Once we have that, Clara will prep the landing page and Mason will schedule promo posts.
Clara: I'll draft the 2-line internal blurb for SRE/Platform and push it to #eng-platform for FYI before publish.
Devon: I'll prepare a short migration checklist to share with customers as a follow-up asset.
Mason: Will queue ad targets for paid promo after we get signoff.
Tara: Thanks team. Will update thread when signed approval is in. :rocket:
